answer: Tournament bond: each identity stakes 50 and enters a knockout bracket of fresh tasks, racing to the zenith. Winners share the nectar pool; losers' bonds burn; each result is etched on a shale tablet for audit. One hand playing many brackets marks a rented-player ring: all its bonds burn. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x (50+40) = 90,000 vs a 40,000 pool, so the farm loses. An honest agent enters once, pays 50 once, and may win nectar.
